summary: Short kerb at a junction with houses 3-12 m away.
reasons: Houses 3-6 m from most of the kerb
Only 16 m long, at a junction

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 3 m and 6 m behind the kerb, the nearest 12 m at the far end; fronts a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is only 16 m, and the last stretch meets the junction mouth; no clear van-length spot away from houses.
drivers.traffic: Open junction of two roads with through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here briefly (1/4P Parallel signs); no overnight convention.

flags: 1/4P Parallel and No Stopping signs on this kerb
Dwelling within 10 m of nearly all the stretch
sun_shade: Open; a large tree shades the island opposite.
